note: The model-tier mapping AGENTS.md "Model Tiers" states, as data a gate and a hook can read. A rule, a Skill, or a brief names a tier, never a model, so a model release is an edit to a `models` value here and to the AGENTS.md table, which spec/validate.py holds equal. Each value is the alias that tool's own subagent dispatch accepts, an alias that already tracks the latest model of its family. A dispatch on a tool with no entry, or on one with no way to name a model per subagent, names no model. The model-tier-guard hook in host-setup/agent-safety/claude/ refuses a dispatch at the maintainerOnly tier's model unless the maintainer allowed it at launch. The agent-safety installer sets the defaultTier's model as the tool's default subagent model. A tool's optional inheritingAgentTypes lists the agent types it builds in that this default does not reach, so a dispatch of one naming no model runs at the session's own model. The same hook refuses that dispatch unless the maintainer allowed the maintainerOnly tier at launch, and an entry without the list names no such type.
